repos_data.description: Local repo-intelligence index + MCP server: semantic search, symbol/graph navigation, impact-surface preflight, git + GitHub papertrail, and a source-anchored memory graph.

Compiler-precise code property graph for C, Python, and TypeScript, navigable over MCP — data- and taint-flow with source→sink witnesses, points-to, and guard/sink structure for security reasoning over source.
Code graph for AI agents: impact analysis and call tracing over MCP (Python, TypeScript). Local, deterministic, SQLite.
Cross-repo code knowledge graph for Java/Kotlin/JS/TS — MCP server, taint analysis, call graph, OWASP reports. 95% fewer tokens than source-reading.
